Priya Nair: hi all, second day here. quick question about ownership: if i need to change a service's route quota or request a dedicated bucket for an experimental feature, who do i ask? onboarding doc lists multiple teams and i'm a bit lost.
Omar Ruiz: welcome Priya! short answer: Platform/Infra owns infra pieces (buckets, cluster roles, kubeconfigs), Product Eng owns service routes and traffic config. If it's infra + route changes, start with Platform and we'll coordinate.
Priya Nair: thanks — and what's the escalation path if something blocks prod deploy? e.g., quota change needed urgently.
Jules Tran: for urgent prod-impacting things: 1) ping #eng-oncall and tag the oncall person, 2) open an incident in PagerDuty (follow the incident playbook), 3) Platform oncall will prioritize infra changes; Eng oncall handles application rollbacks. If it's security-related, also notify sec@redwood.
Priya Nair: good to know. is there a formal owners file for services so i can see who to contact for a specific route?
Omar Ruiz: yes, we have an OWNERS file in each service repo under `infra/owners.md`. it lists primary, secondary, and escalation emails. if the OWNER is stale, open a quick PR to update.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: contractors need manager + people-ops approval for any long-lived credential requests.
Priya Nair: ah — i'm full-time but still waiting on org mapping. should i include my manager on the infra ticket?
Jules Tran: please do. Manager + team lead are required for audit logs on access requests. Also include a purpose (e.g., "dev access for feature X until 2026-06-30").
Priya Nair: one more: who can approve a temporary service-account key? i don't want to request a permanent key if Workload Identity can be used.
Omar Ruiz: Platform prefers Workload Identity. Approvals: Platform eng lead or infra manager sign off for keys >24h. For <24h, oncall can grant timeboxed keys. Always use `gsutil`/IAM console for audits.
Priya Nair: perfect. last nit: onboarding doc mentions "reach out to infra@" but that mailbox seems slow. is #new-hires the recommended place to start?
Jules Tran: start in #new-hires for help and we'll triage in infra. For any SLAs/urgent requests, open a ticket in our internal tracker and tag the channel with the ticket number.
infra-oncall: INFRA-T1234 created by Omar Ruiz: "bootstrap bucket + temp role for priya.nair@redwood-infer.com". ETA 30m.
Priya Nair: thanks everyone! saving this thread for future new hires. :sparkles:
Omar Ruiz: glad to help. ping me directly if the ticket stalls.
Jules Tran: and welcome again :tada:
